data.heading: TravelCorridorSegment
data.text: A segment that is part of a travel corridor.

data.heading: TravelledWayLink
data.text: A linear feature representing a directed edge between two transport nodes in a network graph.

data.heading: TransportNetworkThing
data.text: Any transport-related geographic feature in the ITS transport-network domain. Subclass of its-location:Feature (and therefore geo:Feature).

data.heading: TravelledWayLane
data.text: A linear feature for a single lane along a travelled way.

data.heading: TravelCorridor
data.text: A linear reference for a travel corridor axis (multimodal or policy corridor).

data.heading: VehicleFlowRate
data.text: A non-feature quantity describing vehicle flow on a network element (not a geo:Feature; use its-location:LocationThing).

data.heading: PointOnRoute
data.text: A point feature locating a stop, timing point, or other position on a route.

data.heading: PublicTransportElement
data.text: Abstract element of a public transport system (line, route, stop, etc.).

data.heading: RoadSection
data.text: A contiguous section of a road in a road referencing scheme.

data.heading: MicromobilityPathSegment
data.text: A homogeneous segment of a micromobility path.

data.heading: FootpathSection
data.text: A contiguous section of a footpath.

data.heading: FootpathLane
data.text: A lane or channel along a footpath.

data.heading: RailSection
data.text: A contiguous section of a rail alignment.

data.heading: TravelledWaySection
data.text: A linear feature that aggregates or references a contiguous portion of a travelled way.

data.heading: TransportNetwork
data.text: A set of transport network elements (links, nodes, ways) modelled as an its-location:LocationGroup of member its-location:Feature resources.

data.heading: FootpathLink
data.text: A directed footpath link between nodes.

data.heading: TrackLink
data.text: A directed rail track link between nodes.

data.heading: MicromobilityPathSection
data.text: A contiguous section of a micromobility path.

data.heading: FootpathNetwork
data.text: A transport network for pedestrian paths.

data.heading: MicromobilityNetwork
data.text: A transport network for micromobility (e.g., cycle, scooter) paths.

data.heading: RoadLane
data.text: A lane along a road.

data.heading: TrackSegment
data.text: A homogeneous segment of track.

data.heading: PublicTransportLine
data.text: The linear geometry or reference for a public transport line (service corridor).

data.heading: Footpath
data.text: A travelled way intended primarily for pedestrians.

data.heading: NetworkElement
data.text: Abstract transport network element; concrete instances specialize using its-location:LinearFeature, its-location:PointFeature, its-location:AreaFeature, or its-location:LocationGroup.

data.heading: TransportAlert
data.text: A feature representing a transport alert with spatial extent described by ITS Location geometries.

data.heading: TravelledWaySegment
data.text: A linear feature for the smallest homogeneous piece of a travelled way in a given segmentation scheme.

data.heading: TransportNode
data.text: A point feature at which network links may meet or which anchors linear topology.

data.heading: ScheduledCode
data.text: A location code identifying a scheduled transport reference (e.g., trip, block, or timing group) in an external registry.

data.heading: PublicTransportSystemThing
data.text: Any public transport service or infrastructure feature.

data.heading: RailNetwork
data.text: A transport network for rail infrastructure.

data.heading: MicromobilityLane
data.text: A lane along a micromobility path.

data.heading: PublicTransportRoute
data.text: The linear geometry or reference for a specific public transport route variant.

data.heading: GroupOfLines
data.text: A group of public transport lines modelled as an its-location:LocationGroup.

data.heading: MicromobilityPath
data.text: A travelled way intended for micromobility modes.

data.heading: TransportAlertThing
data.text: Any transport-related alerting or event feature.

data.heading: RoadNetwork
data.text: A transport network whose members are predominantly road network elements.

data.heading: TravelCorridorLink
data.text: A directed link that is part of a travel corridor network.

data.heading: PublicTransportSystem
data.text: A transport network describing routes, lines, and related service elements of a public transport system.

data.heading: TravelledWay
data.text: A linear feature representing a generic travelled way (centreline or reference line).

data.heading: MicromobilityLink
data.text: A directed micromobility link between nodes.

data.heading: RoadLinkUserType
data.text: A code classifying users permitted or typical on a road link.

data.heading: RoadLink
data.text: A directed road network link between nodes.

data.heading: RailCorridor
data.text: A two-dimensional rail corridor footprint or influence area.

data.heading: Road
data.text: A travelled way intended for motor vehicle or mixed road traffic.

data.heading: RoadSegment
data.text: A homogeneous segment of a road.

data.heading: Junction
data.text: A transport node where two or more travelled ways or links connect.

data.heading: FootpathSegment
data.text: A homogeneous segment of a footpath.

data.heading: RoutePoint
data.text: A point feature along a route alignment (e.g., shape point or service point).

data.heading: TransportNetworkObjectProperty
data.text: Super-property for transport network topology and composition.

data.heading: hasStartNode
data.text: The directed start node of a network link (topology), represented as an its-location:PointFeature.

data.heading: hasEndNode
data.text: The directed end node of a network link (topology), represented as an its-location:PointFeature.

data.heading: partOfTravelledWay
data.text: Relates a section, segment, or lane feature to the parent travelled way it refines.

data.heading: partOfTravelCorridor
data.text: Relates a corridor link or corridor segment feature to the parent travel corridor feature.
